target.title: fix: show workboard cards before task enrichment
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Workboard could render as an empty board while the card list was already available. The loader waited for task enrichment through `tasks.list` before publishing `workboard.cards.list` results into UI state. On installations with a large task ledger, `tasks.list` can be slow enough that operators see `0` cards and a long refreshing state even though Workboard data is intact.

## What Changed

- Publish canonical cards, boards, and statuses immediately after `workboard.cards.list` returns.
- Keep task enrichment as a follow-up step so task metadata can still attach after `tasks.list` resolves.
- Preserve the existing live-refresh interaction guard: linked/passive refreshes still defer early publication while a card is dragged, edited, or another write is active.
- Add controller coverage for delayed task enrichment.
- Preserve existing task links during replacement enrichment so loaded cards do not lose their task badges while a new `tasks.list` call is still pending.
- Add Chromium E2E coverage proving a card is visible while `tasks.list` is intentionally held pending, then remains visible after enrichment settles.

## Evidence

Focused unit/browser checks run locally on the PR head:

```text
PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH ../node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/lib/workboard/index.test.ts
-> 179 passed

PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH ../node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/pages/workboard/view.test.ts
-> 68 passed

PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts ui/src/pages/workboard/workboard.e2e.test.ts -t "renders cards while task enrichment is still pending"
-> 1 passed | 3 skipped

git diff --check
-> clean
```

Read-only real installation probe, run against an existing Gateway without config/restart/deploy:

```text
openclaw gateway call workboard.cards.list --json --params '{}' --timeout 20000
-> cards=197, boards=17, statuses=9

time openclaw gateway call tasks.list --json --params '{"limit":500}' --timeout 30000
-> 13.530s, tasks=500, nextCursor=500
```

This confirms the production-shaped timing split: canonical Workboard card data is available independently, while the task ledger page can take long enough to block the first visible render when the UI waits for enrichment before publishing cards.

Browser proof artifacts from the E2E run:

- `.artifacts/control-ui-e2e/workboard/delayed-task-enrichment-card-visible.png` shows the card visible while `tasks.list` is still pending and the toolbar still says Refreshing.
- `.artifacts/control-ui-e2e/workboard/delayed-task-enrichment-settled.png` shows the same card after `tasks.list` resolves and the toolbar returns to Refresh.

## Risk / Notes

This change only affects transient Control UI state publication. It does not change Workboard storage, gateway RPCs, task ledger behavior, config, auth, or lifecycle write semantics.
